Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada. Source: Natural Resources Canada, MRDEM-30. Includes Copernicus WorldDEM-30 (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018.

notes: Segments touching the envelope -116.6, 50.9, -115.5, 51.8 (west, south, east, north; WGS84) were fetched from the dataset's own service; geometry is kept as delivered, with no smoothing or simplification.
Segments are grouped into trails by their published name; unnamed segments are left out. Each group's segments are joined end to end where their ends lie within 30 m.
Day hikes only: 1.5–25 km in total, and not named as a road, parkway, parking area or connector. Up to 20: well-known day hikes in the area first (lib/curate.ts PREFERRED), then the most continuous.

Length: Sum of great-circle (haversine, R = 6,371,008.8 m) distances between consecutive vertices of the published geometry, over every part. Segment ends within 30 m are joined, which adds at most that straight step per join; gaps between parts are not counted, and parts shorter than 10 m (digitising slivers) are left out.
Climb: the main part sampled with the Unmap Elevation API at the spacing the app's elevation profile uses, so the profile in the app shows the same numbers while the DEM release is unchanged.
Difficulty: as published in the source's "Summer_Classification_Été" field.
Trail conditions, closures and seasonal restrictions are not part of this data.
